name: Brook and bridge
observations: Native075 shows a narrow watercourse below the bridge, vegetated banks and tree canopy.
Grey vertical-bar metal railings span the pavement edge above water; concrete/stone-like base strip at bottom.
Low brick walls, side buildings and distant upper windows frame the brook.
Overhead wires and utility pole appear independently above; do not model them as facade edges.
Native075 is April2019 imagery; its old background/shop state differs from newer route captures.
Create bridge deck, water, banks and railings as separate assets.
unknowns: Channel depth, underside structure and drainage details are not visible. Width/direction inferred from photographs only.
review_basis: All listed captures reviewed in contact sheets; selected originals also inspected at native resolution. Notes describe visible appearance, not surveyed construction.
placement_confidence: Approximate frontage marker derived from camera route, side and estimated offset; not a measured footprint.
